function: LLM proposes placement and beamforming targets (beam-steering reference points) of multiple RISs to maximize indoor coverage; GA refines locally, DiRect enforces diversity (pp. 3-8).
system: Transmitter at (0,40) m, scalar signal model, antenna count not stated; passive reflecting RISs, 256 elements, lambda/2 spacing; 3 GHz; 60x80 m warehouse (pp. 4, 9).
method: Pretrained LLM (GPT-4o via API) prompted with layout and coverage maps proposes configurations; GA refines; DiRect regenerates diverse ones; no training or fine-tuning described (pp. 5-9).
data_channel: Custom deterministic ray-tracing model (LoS and first-order specular reflection, free-space path loss) of a 2D warehouse; no 3GPP model, dataset or measurement (pp. 4-5).
test_conditions: No training stage described for the proposed method; each layout, RIS count, element count and BS position is optimised separately; 20 trials in the runtime test (pp. 9-13).
baselines: Non-learned: GA from scratch, Random. Learned: TD3 (RL). Ablations: LLM only, LLM_GA, which are variants of the proposed method (p. 8).
metrics: Coverage ratio (%), iterations to reach the coverage threshold, total runtime with GPU and memory use, final coverage per LLM (pp. 9-13).
complexity: Measured runtime: proposed 20.32 min total (2.69 min per iteration) versus GA 1562.67 min and TD3 1394.44 min, with 6 RISs and 90% coverage (Table II, p. 9).
openness: none; no code or data link, LLMs accessed through official APIs, data from the authors' own simulator (pp. 3, 9).
q1_support: p. 4: "We adopt a deterministic channel model that accounts for LoS and first-order specular reflection paths" with a free-space path loss: a custom ray-based warehouse simulator, not 3GPP TR 38.901, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 8: "We train TD3 for up to 1500 episodes with early stopping once the target coverage is reached" is the only training; the proposed LLM framework has no training stage and each layout, RIS count and BS position is optimised separately, so no trained model is tested on unseen conditions.
q3_support: p. 8: "applies a traditional genetic algorithm initialized from scratch" and Random are non-learned; "Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) to optimise multi-RIS deployment" is the learned baseline; p. 10: "superior steady-state coverage compared with all baselines".
q4_support: p. 9: "the Proposed framework achieves the shortest total runtime", with Table II giving 20.32 min total versus 1562.67 min for GA and 1394.44 min for TD3 (6 RISs, 90% coverage): a measured runtime.
q5_support: p. 3: "we develop a deterministic channel model to evaluate the received signal distribution across the warehouse" is the authors' own simulator; no code or data link or DOI is given and no public dataset or measurement is used.
notes: Borderline learned component: no training or fine-tuning, a pretrained LLM (GPT-4o) is prompted as the planner, kept as learned together with GA refinement. RIS placement is deployment planning, but the beam targets (RIS beams) are chosen jointly with it, so above_phy does not apply; area 3.
